purpose: Define the next GPU-owned construction boundary after device-side init-state replication: construct the bounded XuanTie-E902 IAHB program-image bytes from the source-backed case.pat word/lane contract on device before resident eval.
weakest_point: This is only a construction boundary definition for case.pat-backed IAHB instruction memory; it is not broad ROM initialization, not x_smem/x_dmem coverage, not ISA correctness, and not full software boot correctness.

source_contract.word_index_mapping: case.pat word index i maps to x_iahb_mem_ctrl.ram0..3.mem[i]

construction_scope.input: source-backed case.pat words or equivalent word/lane records
construction_scope.device_side_output: x_iahb_mem_ctrl.ram0..3.mem root storage bytes for each state
construction_scope.host_device_traffic_goal: upload compact program-image records once, then construct per-state IAHB memory bytes on device
construction_scope.relationship_to_device_side_init_state_r: init-state replication remains the base full-state replication path; this boundary moves semantically meaningful program-image construction onto GPU for the selected IAHB memory family

program_image_initialization_inputs.source: case.pat words or equivalent word/lane records
program_image_initialization_inputs.minimal_record_policy: only upload records for source-backed IAHB program-image bytes that differ from the replicated base init-state or are required to materialize the selected program image
program_image_initialization_inputs.batch_semantics: records are uploaded once and applied for each GPU state before resident eval

device_upload_layout.provenance: word_index/lane remain host-side validation metadata until the runtime needs device-side source decoding

application_semantics.apply_scope: apply every record to every GPU state before the first resident eval step
application_semantics.ordering: records are applied in ascending input order; duplicate target_root_offset records are rejected by the host contract before upload

size_policy.offset_width: native size_t in host runtime, matching existing ResidentPatchSchedule offsets
size_policy.record_count_limit: must fit unsigned record_count in the current runtime scheduling model

program_image_initialization_record_form.relationship_to_resident_patch_schedule: reuse the proven offset/value SoA upload shape, but run once before resident eval instead of once per logical patch step

runtime_support.required_lowering: reuse named case.pat word/lane lowering to generated root field offsets for x_iahb_mem_ctrl.ram0..3.mem
must_not_use: hand-written root byte offsets as source of truth
broad x_smem_ctrl or x_dmem_ctrl initialization without a source image contract
per-state host-side full-state construction as the accepted final boundary

definition_gate: gate identifies the source-backed program image and selected memory family
gate names required runtime support before claiming implementation
gate states non-claims for broad ROM/memory and ISA/software correctness
future_validation_gate: CPU/source-backed construction and GPU/device-side construction produce matching final state under normalized_final_state_equivalence
construction input is derived from case.pat word/lane records or equivalent source-backed records
host-device upload traffic is measured separately from resident eval throughput
